description: A treasury director must approve a 90-day investment plan for a temporary $18,000,000 cash surplus and finalize the maturity ladder and deposit controls, with input from counterparty risk, cash forecasting, and treasury operations.

shared_context.S1: The company has a temporary $18,000,000 cash surplus available for investment for up to 90 days.
shared_context.S2: Harbor Bank has quoted a competitive 90-day certificate of deposit for the full amount.
shared_context.S3: The preliminary treasury proposal places the full $18,000,000 in Harbor Bank's 90-day certificate of deposit.
shared_context.S4: Maya makes the binding investment decision.
shared_context.S5: At the daily cash committee, Maya routinely takes a brief report from counterparty risk, cash forecasting, and treasury operations before approving an investment plan.

PF1.text: Jonas confirmed in this morning's counterparty review that Harbor Bank's approved deposit limit for this company is exactly $5,000,000; the limit was added to the risk register this morning and is not yet reflected in the treasury proposal.

PF2.text: Elena confirmed today's payment forecast with accounts payable: exactly $6,000,000 must mature on day 30 and exactly $4,000,000 must mature on day 60. The remaining $8,000,000 may mature on day 90; she received the confirmation this morning but has not updated the cash model.

PF3.text: Ravi found in the current deposit-control manual this week that any bank deposit above $1,000,000 requires a signed collateralized-deposit agreement before funding; this control has not yet been added to the operations checklist.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly $5,000,000 may be placed in Harbor Bank's certificate of deposit.
Exactly $6,000,000 must be invested in an instrument maturing on day 30.
Exactly $4,000,000 must be invested in an instrument maturing on day 60.
Exactly $3,000,000 of government instruments must mature on day 90 in addition to the $5,000,000 Harbor certificate.
The full $18,000,000 surplus must be allocated.
A signed collateralized-deposit agreement must be required before funding the Harbor certificate.

content_checks.C7: 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and decisions['collateralized_deposit_agreement_before_funding'] == True and any('collateralized-deposit agreement' in c['detail'] and 'before funding' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The preliminary plan places all $18,000,000 with Harbor Bank, while PF1 changes harbor_cd_usd to exactly $5,000,000 and supplies the risk basis that must be cited.
The preliminary plan has no early maturities, while PF2 changes the ladder to exactly $6,000,000 on day 30, $4,000,000 on day 60, and exactly $3,000,000 of government instruments on day 90.

The preliminary plan contains no deposit execution control, while PF3 changes collateralized_deposit_agreement_before_funding to true and requires a commitment whose detail states that a signed collateralized-deposit agreement is required before funding.
